name: use-reactions
title: useReactions
description: useReactions: the reactions block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the reactions block (`npx better-supabase add reactions`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/reactions.
